jobs.occupation: VP Strategic HR Business Partner - CSO (all genders) (HR Business Partner)
jobs.description:
The VP Strategic HR Business Partner (SHRBP) for the Chief Scientific Officer (CSO) is a strategic leadership role responsible for aligning people strategy with Evotec’s overarching goals, particularly in the realms of AI, innovation, Therapeutic Area expertise and scientific excellence. Reporting to the Head of HR Business Partners, this position serves as a trusted advisor to the CSO and their global leadership team, driving initiatives that enable Evotec’s success in cutting-edge, high-performance environments.

The GHRBP works closely with senior leaders to shape and define the company’s AI and innovation strategy from a people perspective, ensuring that talent, organizational structures, and culture enable the company’s scientific and technological ambitions. This role partners with HR Centers of Expertise (CoEs) and local HRBP Communities teams to implement integrated, data-driven HR solutions that foster business agility, drive transformation, and enhance Evotec’s position as a leader in partnership with the life sciences, AI, and biotech sectors.

Key Deliverables and Accountabilities 

Strategic Partnership & Advisory

- Act as a strategic partner to the CSO, advising on all elements of the HR value chain, including organizational design, talent acquisition, leadership development, and succession planning.
- Partner with the CSO and other business leaders to help define and develop the organizational capabilities and talent needs to support the CSO function
- Lead the alignment and execution of the Global Evotec People Strategy with the company’s scientific vision, ensuring that the people strategy is a catalyst for growth, innovation, and competitive advantage.
- Talent Strategy and People Solutions Partner with senior leadership to define and implement a forward-looking talent strategy that enables Evotec’s AI and innovation ambitions.
- Provide strategic insight into the design and development of the company’s innovation culture, ensuring the people agenda is fully aligned with fostering creativity, agility, and a future-ready workforce.
- Collaborate closely with leadership to create organizational structures that support Evotec’s transformation ambitions.
- Advise CSO and Leadership Team on all people-related matters.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

- Serve as the primary HR interface with the CoE leaders in Total Rewards, Workforce Solutions, Talent Management, and HR Operations, ensuring seamless alignment between the people strategy and business objectives
- Build and nurture relationships with executive leadership, local HR teams, and functional leaders to ensure the consistent implementation of strategic HR initiatives across geographies.
- Serve as a key partner in driving collaboration between HR and technology leaders, helping to foster a culture of innovation and high performance across the organization.

Organizational Effectiveness & Transformation

- Lead efforts to define and address organizational capability gaps that hinder business and innovation performance.
- Design and implement change management initiatives that enable organizational agility
- Foster a growth mindset culture that is inclusive, agile, and results-driven, supporting the company’s transformation into a leading innovator in the life sciences and biotech industries.

Operational Excellence

- Collaborate with Finance and Business Operations to manage headcount, labor costs, and people investments in a manner that is aligned with strategic innovation goals.
- Oversee annual HR processes such as salary reviews, incentive payouts, and performance cycles, ensuring alignment with business and innovation objectives.
- Define and track HR and business KPIs, enabling data-driven decision-making to optimize the workforce for future needs, particularly in AI and scientific advancements.

Qualifications & Experience

- Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related field; advanced degree (e.g., MBA, MSc) preferred.
- Several years of progressive HR experience, with substantial exposure to global HR business partnering in life sciences, biotech, or AI-driven organizations.
- Proven ability to partner with executive leaders in complex, matrixed organizations to define and implement strategic people initiatives that align with business and innovation goals.
- Expertise in all aspects of the HR value chain, including organizational design, leadership development, and change management, with a deep understanding of how people strategy can support AI integration and innovation.
- Strong business acumen with the ability to translate strategic objectives into actionable, data-driven HR initiatives that propel growth and organizational excellence.
- Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills across diverse cultural and geographic settings.
- Comfortable in fast-paced, highly innovative environments, with an ability to balance strategic vision and tactical execution.
- Language Proficiency: Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English and German are required.

Personal Attributes

- Strategic thinker with a strong ability to drive data-backed decisions that advance both innovation and business performance.
- High integrity, professionalism, and a commitment to confidentiality and ethical leadership.
- Proactive and results-oriented, with the ability to manage ambiguity and complexity in a rapidly changing landscape.
- A genuine interest in enabling people success and building a culture of innovation, with a deep understanding of the impact that a forward-thinking people strategy can have on technological and scientific outcomes.

About Allianz Global Investors

Allianz Global Investors is a leading active asset manager, managing assets for individuals, families, and institutions worldwide. Our shared goal to shape a future of opportunity for our clients is foundational to our culture and our values. We look to attract, and actively nurture, individuals with the drive to achieve excellence at every stage of the investment experience.

We believe an inclusive culture is key to a flourishing workforce. Not only do we celebrate the broad range of experiences, backgrounds, and attributes that our workforce brings, but we support our people to live and work in a way that promotes their own wellbeing.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges is what makes us a unique employer.  

We are united by a shared commitment: to put our clients first and at the centre of everything we do. Their needs inspire our thinking and guide our actions.  

Together, we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and confident to explore, grow and shape a better future - for our clients and for the world around us. At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. The foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and where integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust are at the heart of our culture.  

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations. 

If you feel inspired to promote the active asset management experience, this is the place for you. Join our international, technology-enabled, and agile environment. Simply upload your CV in English to apply for this position.  If you need support to navigate our websites or at any stage during your application, please send an email with your request to recruiting@allianzgi.com. 

To Recruitment Agencies:

Allianz Global Investors has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz Global Investors does not accept unsolicited resumes from agency or search firm recruiters.

When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place.

Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz Global Investors.

Finally, please do not contact hiring managers directly.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

How to Apply: Applying is quick and easy. Simply upload your CV, complete your personal details, confirm your consent for AI support in the "Additional Information" section, and submit your application.

To support our recruiters, we use Fit Score—an AI‑powered tool that highlights how closely your profile aligns with the role. This helps us review applications more efficiently and focus on what matters most: your skills and experience.

Good to know: The Fit Score is a support tool only. At Allianz, technology never replaces human judgment. Every application is carefully reviewed by our recruiting teams, ensuring a fair, thoughtful, and personal hiring process.

The Leibniz Institute of Virology (LIV) is an independent research institution for basic biomedical research. As a foundation under civil law and member of the Leibniz Association, the institute occupies a leading position both nationally and internationally.

The Research Department Viral Zoonoses - One Health, headed by Prof. Dr. Gülşah Gabriel, investigates the interspecies transmission of influenza A viruses from animals to humans and the molecular mechanisms of pathogenesis in humans, particularly with regard to risk factors (pregnancy, obesity, and gender dependence). The department aims to identify and characterize viral and cellular determinants driving increased pathogenicity and transmissibility. These insights are further extended to other respiratory viruses, including SARS-CoV-2 and RSV, with particular attention to post-acute sequelae and their long-term impact. Ultimately, the knowledge gained will inform the development of novel antiviral strategies.

We are looking for a highly motivated, ambitious, and team-oriented candidate for a

Postdoc Position (f/m/x)
Conduct and shape a research project on the pathogenesis of respiratory virus infections under BSL-2 and BSL-3 conditions
Work as an independent researcher with accountability towards the research project
Preparation and submission of animal experimentation applications in compliance with regulatory requirements, including direct liaison with the relevant authorities to ensure timely approval
Integrate into the research team and provide support for junior members / students
Present research findings at national and international level
Develop future research projects and draft manuscripts

Solid expertise in virology or cell biology and experimental laboratory work
Experience in conducting animal experiments
Strong commitment, team spirit, very good communication and organizational skills, and ability to work in an independent and flexible manner
PhD degree in life sciences
Very good German and English language skills (oral and written)

Working as part of a highly motivated team in a state-of-the-art, international research environment with excellent core facilities
Remuneration according to EG 13 TV-AVH (Hamburg Employment Law Association Collective Agreement) (comparable to TVöD - Civil Service Collective Agreement), including company pension scheme
30 days of annual vacation
Opportunity to obtain FELASA C certification, providing the qualification to independently conduct animal experimentation
Further training opportunities, including subsidized English and German courses at the institute
Grant for unscheduled child care
Health protection offers at the institute (in cooperation with voiio GmbH)
Flexible, family-friendly working hours
HVV Deutschlandticket subsidy
Canteen use subsidy

The position is initially limited for two years with starting date January 1, 2027.

The LIV is certified with the TOTAL E-QUALITY distinction and promotes work-life balance and professional equality between employees of all genders. Severely disabled persons will be given preferential consideration if their suitability, qualifications, and professional performance are otherwise equal.

jobs.occupation: Student Activity - Technology Analyst for Physical AI, Honda R&D Europe (Deutschland) GmbH (Wertpapieranalyst/in)
jobs.description: Topic This position involves investigating and evaluating emerging trends and technologies in Physical AI, with a focus on the interaction between artificial intelligence, robotics, and other intelligent physical systems. Particular attention will be given to how the interaction and coordination of these systems can enhance and expand production capabilities. Background Physical AI is one of the key technology drivers for the factory of the future, enabling intelligent robots, adaptive machines, and autonomous systems capable of understanding and interacting with their environment. As an OEM, we continuously monitor scientific and industrial developments throughout Europe and beyond to identify promising technologies, establish collaborations, and derive future innovation strategies. Target Systematic investigation, evaluation of relevant trends, technologies, research activities and industrial developments in the field of Artificial Intelligence for Physical and Autonomous Systems Investigation and evaluation of Physical AI applications for production equipment and logistics networks Identification and assessment of leading research institutes, universities, startups, and industrial players Analysis of technological trends, opportunities, and challenges for future intelligent systems Preparation and communication of analyses and recommendations for internal and external stakeholders Support in establishing collaborations with academic and industrial partners You should meet the following requirements Currently enrolled in a studies program (bachelor's or master's) in a relevant field (Engineering, Computer Science, Natural Sciences, Information Technology, or a comparable technical field) Good understanding of artificial intelligence, machine learning, robotics, or related areas Experience with literature research, technology scouting, programming, or data analysis is advantageous Strong interest in technology and innovations Very good English skills, both written and spoken Self-motivated, creative, independent, and proactive team player with an open and communicative personality Are you ready... ... for exciting insights into professional practice amidst innovative technologies and human-centered design? Then we look forward to receiving your application.

Your Role

Data and AI are reshaping the way global organizations operate, and this role sits at the heart of that transformation. As a Software Engineer within our Enabling Functions Data Office, you will design and deliver high-impact data and AI solutions that power smarter ways of working across the organization. You will be part of a collaborative, internationally distributed team of engineers and architects, working within a Product-Oriented Delivery model to bring Analytics, AI, and data products to life at scale.

In this role, you will:

- Design, build, and maintain scalable applications, data pipelines, and platform components that translate complex business requirements from enabling functions such as HR, procurement, and legal into future-ready technical solutions.
- Develop robust applications and interfaces that replace manual processes with seamless, intuitive user experiences.
- Take ownership of data platforms, ensuring cost efficiency, governance, security, and compliance across the full data lifecycle.
- Partner closely with stakeholders across your delivery pod to understand business needs and shape the technical direction of solutions.
- Shape the future of data engineering within Enabling Functions, leveraging platforms such as Snowflake, AWS, and Palantir Foundry.
- Contribute to a growing Spain-based hub within a global team, with the opportunity to work on diverse and high-visibility AI use cases spanning automation, carbon footprint analytics, procurement intelligence, and more.

Who You Are

- You bring several years of proven expertise and experience in software engineering, including application design, development, and delivery within enterprise environments, with a strong foundation in writing clean, maintainable, and secure code.
- You are proficient in development platforms and languages such as Python and Spark, and you apply modern engineering practices including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing as a matter of course.
- You have hands-on experience with data platform technologies such as Palantir Foundry, Snowflake, and PySpark, and you are confident designing and delivering end-to-end data pipelines.
- You have a solid understanding of data pipeline architecture, data governance, data lineage, privacy and security controls, and compliance standards in enterprise-scale environments.
- You communicate complex technical concepts clearly and confidently to non-technical stakeholders, and you are comfortable translating business requirements into actionable technical solutions.
- Familiarity with AI workflows, MLOps, AI safety and guardrails, or CI/CD for AI components is a plus
- You hold a university degree or equivalent qualification in a relevant technical or engineering discipline.
- You are comfortable working in a distributed, international team environment and are open to occasional travel within Europe.
- Strong communication skills in English ; proficiency in German is a plus.

The GWDG is seeking a

Quantum Computing Expert (m/f/d)

to join an interdisciplinary team of HPC experts in the working group “Computing” (AG C), full-time (39 hours perweek), remunerated in accordance with TVöD E 13. The position is tied to the GWDG QC project’s runtime running tillOctober 2029. The successful candidate is expected to contribute in developing GWDG’s QC ecosystem (seeresponsibilities listed below). The GWDG handles sensitive data, and in such cases, it is important that the code ishuman-verified for any security concerns. The applicant must demonstrate the ability to do such a verification withoutAI assistance in the interview.

The Gesellschaft für wissenschaftliche Datenverarbeitung mbH Göttingen (GWDG) is the university computing centerfor the Georg-August-Universität Göttingen and a computing and IT competence center for the Max Planck Society.The provision of high-performance HPC systems has been one of its tasks for over 40 years. In 2020, the Universityof Göttingen / GWDG was accepted as one of eight computing centers (NHR-Nord@Göttingen) in the National High-Performance Computing (NHR) network. The GWDG also operates the national AI service center KISSKI and is apartner in the EU AI Factory HammerHAI. Furthermore, the GWDG operates HPC resources for the GermanAerospace Center (DLR). As a national supercomputing center, the GWDG provides technical support to researchersand students from various scientific domains, including digital humanities, life science, earth system science, andengineering. We also participate in both national and international research projects. In the field of quantumcomputing, the GWDG also runs the QUICS project, providing SMEs with access to quantum computing resources.

We are looking for highly motivated candidates to join the QC team at the GWDG focused on anomaly detection forindustry applications. The goal is to build a platform for such use cases based on existing stacks, giving companies atool for quantum anomaly detection.

The GWDG together with the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science and the Campus Institute Data Science(CIDAS) of the University of Göttingen provides a stimulating research environment in Scientific Computing, with anopportunity to conduct research in the intersection of applied computer science, High-Performance Computing,Quantum Computing, and AI.

Responsibilities

Focus:

Integration of quantum-based algorithms into classical computing environments, and system-levelstability/error analysis of the integrated hybrid stack.

The role goes beyond merely operating existing quantum software stacks. It also involves designing modular,hardware-agnostic backends capable of seamlessly integrating both simulators and current NISQ devices. Thisrequires:

Running simulations on HPC systems, including efficiently parallelizing computational tasks

Writing HPC-executable, production-ready code

Ensuring scalability and robustness of algorithms in large-scale environments

Identifying and resolving error sources in the integrated hybrid stack, particularly cascading errors acrossmodules

Developing independent code for simulations, extending beyond the use of standard software libraries

Requirements

PhD and/or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Physics, or a related field, combined with demonstrableindustry or research experience

Proven coding experience (without AI assistance): scope, functions, variables, classes, array methods, etc.

Good knowledge of diverse quantum hardware, error correction/mitigation strategies, and respective SDKecosystems (Qiskit, Cirq, Braket, Qrisp, AutoQML, etc.)

Advanced linear algebra knowledge: matrix diagonalization methods, magnus expansion, Zassenhausformula, group theory

Advanced quantum physics knowledge: quantum circuit design, Trotterization, quantum machine learning, etc

Demonstrated experience running simulations on HPC systems

Excellent teamwork and communication skills

Fluent English (spoken and written)

Do you fit all the above requirements? Then we welcome your application!

Desirable

Hands-on experience with multiple quantum SDKs (Qiskit, Cirq, Amazon Braket, PennyLane)

Experience implementing or working with quantum error mitigation/correction techniques

Experience running large-scale quantum simulations on HPC clusters (e.g., GPU-accelerated state-vector ortensor-network simulators)

Contributions to open-source quantum computing libraries, or published work on quantum algorithms

Familiarity with ion-trap or other NISQ hardware platforms

Knowledge in writing bash scripts for HPC job submission

German B2 or higher

Our offer

Flexible working hours and opportunity for partial mobile working

A modern, diverse work environment at the intersection between academia and industry

An interesting, versatile job in a large, internationally operating IT competence center

Qualification and further development of your skills

Social benefits of the public sector

Your application

Have we sparked your interest? Then please send us your application by 30.09.2026 via our online form:

https://bewerbermanagement.net/67hhg

The GWDG strives for gender equity and diversity and therefore welcomes applications from any background. TheGWDG strives to employ more severely disabled people. Applications from severely disabled persons are expresslyencouraged.

If you have any questions about the advertised position, please contact Dr. Jan Cillié Louw (e-mail:

jancillie.louw@gwdg.de ).

jobs.occupation: Sales Manager – B2B Dietary Supplements Industry (f/m/d) (Sales-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Would you like to work for one of the most innovative companies in Hamburg?

PlantaCorp is an ISO 22000- and GMP-certified German manufacturer of liposomal dietary supplements. Our unique, advanced technology for encapsulating vital nutrients provides our customers with highly effective, maximally absorbable liposomal supplements. Our 1,500 m² state-of-the-art production facility as well as our office spaces are located in Eidelstedt, Hamburg. 

At PlantaCorp, we support our business partners in conquering the global market through both contract manufacturing and white-label services. Together, we are shaping the future by creating a new perspective on dietary supplements. Our goal is to make our modern and innovative liposomal technology accessible to everyone. 

To move closer to this goal, we are looking for a:

Sales Manager – B2B Dietary Supplements Industry (f/m/d) 

Full-time, 40 hours

Responsibilities:

- acquisition of new customers
- building your own customer base, identifying customer potential, and sustainably developing it further
- independent order management from handling customer inquiries, calculating sales prices, preparing offers, through to negotiating with customers
- deriving measures to increase sales activities
- ensuring customer retention and customer satisfaction
- acting as an interface between customers and the R&D department within the scope of product development
- daily documentation and maintenance of your activities and customer conversations in our CRM tool (HubSpot)
- participation in trade shows

Required Qualifications:

- minimum of 2 years of professional experience in sales (new customer acquisition focus)
- you enjoy making phone calls and building customer relationships
- you are communicative and enjoy approaching people
- you have experience in sales and enjoy the process of customer acquisition
- you are conscientious, reliable, and open to exciting projects
- you enjoy connecting people and solving problems
- you can inspire others and stand out with strong persuasive skills
- you speak English fluently and to a negotiation-level
- background in the dietary supplements industry (food industry) preferred

Mutual respect, reliability, and personal initiative are a given for us. 

Why PlantaCorp:

We offer you a challenging role in a diverse environment, with an open-door policy and flat hierarchies. In our highly innovative and fast-growing company, you will have the opportunity to implement your own projects and develop personally. With the right commitment and a strong sense of quality, everyone has the chance to take on more responsibility.

What PlantaCorp Offers You: 

- Individual commission agreement
- Development into a top sales professional – you will receive one of the highest-quality, accompanying sales coaching on the market
- An international and dynamic team
- Daily coffee, tea, as well as milk and oat milk
- Fresh fruit twice a week
- Two free dietary supplements of your choice per month, plus employee discounts on our products
- Good public transport connections
- Subsidy for your Germany ticket
- Weekly on-site yoga
- Subsidy for an Urban Sports membership
- German language courses
- Company events

Interested?
Then we look forward to receiving your electronic application, optionally also in the form of a short 2-minute video in which you explain why you are suitable for new customer acquisition or we look forward to receiving your application, which should include a resume, a brief cover letter explaining your motivation and relevant experience, as well as your highest level of education and all available employment references:

PlantaCorp is an ISO 22000 and GMP-certified producer of liposomal supplements based in Hamburg, Germany.

We are currently seeking for our Headquarter in Hamburg a highly motivated and dedicated
 
Specialist Group Consolidation & Reporting (all genders)

Full-time and permanent

Responsibilities:

- Preparation of consolidated financial statements of Evotec Group (listed on Frankfurt Stock Exchange and Nasdaq) in accordance with IFRS, including notes, disclosures, and management reporting
- Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, stock‑exchange obligations, and internal reporting standards.
- Support in the year‑end and quarterly audit processes, working closely with external auditors
- Collaborate with our Subsidiaries in all Group accounting and consolidation matters
- Review internal reporting packages, ensuring data quality and consistency across the Group.
- Support in optimization of processes and procedures related to preparation of Group Financial Statements, as well as further development of our consolidation software Onestream
- Support IFRS accounting assessments, including leases and fixed assets

Required Qualifications:

- Successful university degree (or equivalent) in business administration, advanced studies in international accounting, group accounting or auditing
- 2+ years of experience in Group Accounting, ideally within a publicly listed company
- Experience in a Big Four firm is a strong advantage
- Expertise in IFRS, including hands‑on experience with IFRS accounting assessments
- Good understanding of consolidation processes, reporting systems, and internal controls, ideally Hyperion or Onestream
- Proactive mindset, high attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a dynamic environment.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with stakeholders across multiple countries and functions
- Fluent in German and English

Our offer:

- A permanent position within a vigorous and exciting professional environment promoted by an open culture, a spirit of community and continuous improvement
- A diverse, international workforce with a dynamic working environment that fosters creativity, innovation, and teamwork
- 30 days annual holiday, monthly allowance for public transportation, and in-house canteen
- Capital forming benefits, flexible working hours, holiday pay, and annual bonus depending on performance

To apply, please click on the “Apply” button and provide your application documents (CV and cover letter, including earliest possible start date and salary requirements). We are looking forward to getting to know you and to your application.

Who we are

The Product Design Center of TK Elevator Innovation and Operations GmbH is responsible for the development of product features, harmonized global product platforms, as well as the conception and development of complete escalator and moving walk system types. Working in international teams alongside colleagues from our development centers in China and Spain, we create innovations for the efficient escalators and moving walks of the future.
The international nature of our work is reflected in the close collaboration and regular exchange with experts from various engineering disciplines worldwide. In addition, our proximity to manufacturing at our Hamburg site ensures close integration between development and production, enabling us to support development projects directly on the production line and through their market launch.

What we expect

- Specification, programming, and testing of embedded software in C/C++ for ARM-based control systems.
- Development and Design of electrical systems for escalators, including drives, safety, lighting, and sensors.
- Creation and maintenance of complex circuit diagrams, assembly layouts and project templates including programming of PLC-based simulators and test benches.
- Certification of functional safety and cybersecurity systems according to the standards IEC 61508 and IEC 62443.
- Cross-functional collaboration with Product Management, Manufacturing, Purchasing, Quality and Service.
- Definition and execution of test plans for validating designs according to acceptance criteria.
- Technical support during commissioning, testing, and failure analysis at national and international customer sites.

Who we are looking for

- Degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a comparable discipline (university or university of applied sciences).
- Strong microcontroller programming skills in C/C++, ideally complemented by PLC programming experience (e.g., Siemens S7, TwinCAT).
- 5–10 years of professional experience in Research und Development, preferably in electronics or electrical engineering.
- Confident use of IAR Embedded Workbench and Atlassian tools. Experience with Parasoft, TwinCAT, EPLAN, or Altium is considered an advantage.
- Knowledge of standards IEC 61508 and IEC 62443, as well as experience in the elevator/escalator sector, is an advantage.
- Functional Safety Engineer (FSE) certification is an advantage.
- Experience in electrical testing (electrical safety, electromagnetic compatibility, etc.) is an advantage.
- Project management knowledge is an advantage.
- Team-oriented mindset with strong communication skills and a structured way of working.
- High level of initiative and enthusiasm for technical innovation.
- Business fluent in English and German.
- Willingness to travel internationally.

What we offer

- Health and Safety – Highest standards and a wide range of health promotion and healthcare activities
- Flexibility – We support, for example, through flexible yet regulated working hours and remote working options
- Compensation und pension – Fair working conditions, competitive compensation, following “Collective Agreements” and support with pension schemes
- Collaboration und diversity – Collegiality is of huge importance – we treat everyone with respect and appreciation
- Development – Individual support to help you get started in your new job as well as training and education programs to help you develop professionally and personally
- Creative leeway – We offer an environment in which you can try out new solutions in a no-blame-culture
- Sustainability – We act with responsibility and environmental awareness
- Attractive Location: Subsidized cafeteria, a convenient location in Hamburg with parking, and excellent access to public transportation.

Contact

Please apply online in English including your salary expectation and your notice period.

About the Role:

As a Performance Specialist, you will operate close to the shopfloor and contribute to the sustainable improvement of equipment as well as process performance within a Production Unit. By driving Continuous Improvement, FOX, AM/PM and Smart Factory initiatives, you will identify performance opportunities, support the implementation of improvement measures and play a key role in strengthening operational excellence and long-term performance results.

Main Responsibilities:

- Analyze equipment and process losses and identify improvement opportunities to increase Production Unit performance
- Support the preparation, facilitation, and follow-up of FOX workshops and Continuous Improvement initiatives
- Implement and further develop Lean methodologies and Operational Excellence standards within the Production Unit (PU)
- Monitor and track action plans using the PDCA methodology to ensure effective and sustainable implementation
- Support the deployment and continuous development of Autonomous and Preventive Maintenance (AM/PM) practices
- Contribute to the analysis and improvement of key performance indicators, with a particular focus on OEE and OAE
- Support leaders and operational teams in fostering a culture of Continuous Improvement and the adoption of best practicesc
- Partner closely with the Production Unit to drive initiatives that improve the efficiency, stability, and productivity of manufacturing processes

About You:

- University degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Production Systems Engineering or a comparable technical field
- First professional experience in a manufacturing environment, ideally in Operational Excellence, Continuous Improvement or Lean Management
- Knowledge of Lean methodologies such as 5S, Kaizen, SMED, or comparable approaches
- Interest in production systems, performance management and digitalization
- Strong analytical and structured approach combined with problem-solving skills
- High level of initiative, ownership and accountability
- Strong communication and teamwork skills
- Fluent German and English, both written and spoken
